description.message: Speed up your downloads with Aria2, manage your download tasks easily.

checkAltClickDes.message: Prevent download interception by pressing Alt key

checkAltClickTip.message: Prevent download interception when pressing the Alt key and clicking on a link. New setting will take effect after refreshing pages.

downloadCaptureDes.message: Enable auto capture when download file size

askBeforeDownloadDes.message: Ask detail settings before auto download

allowExternalRequestDes.message: Receive Aria2 download request from other extension

monitorAllTip.message: When multiple Aria2 servers are set, monitor all the status of them and display the aggregate results.

badgeTextDes.message: Mark tasks amount via icon badge

captureMagnetWarn.message: OS level capture, please ensure disabling before uninstall.

captureMagnetTip.message: Click 'No' on Windows prompts UAC confirm dialog, if you don't want the system level capture.

allowedSitesPlaceholderDes.message: Set domains or extension IDs to intercept, one per line, regular expressions supported. (Allow-list has higher priority)

blockedSitesPlaceholderDes.message: Set domains or extension IDs to exclude from interception, one per line, regular expressions supported, * means all.

allowedExtsPlaceholderDes.message: Set the file types that you want to capture or export, one extension per line, * means all. (Allow-List has higher priority)

blockedExtsPlaceholderDes.message: Set the file types that you un-want to capture or export, one extension per line, * means all.

windowBlurCloseDes.message: Close window automatically when focus is lost

configCloudSyncDes.message: Sync Web UI and extension configs to current logged-in Browser account

uploadConfigWarn.message: Invalid or empty local config data, still continue?

downloadConfigFailed.message: Configs download failed: Data invalid or network disconnected.

OverwriteAriaNgRpcWarn.message: RPC settings have changed. Synchronize these changes to Web UI and overwrite?

RpcUrlTooltipWarnDes.message: Creating download task over insecure HTTP/WebSocket protocol can potentially expose Secret Key and related website Cookies on the public network.

AutoDownloadCookiesTooltipDes.message: For insecure RPC, the related website cookies will not be attached when auto-download or direct export.

ManualDownloadCookiesTooltipDes.message: You should determine whether to delete the related website cookies when asking download settings.

Aria2ManagerPromotionDes.message: It seems Aria2 Manager is not installed, access "Alex Recommends" channel for more information?

ResetSettingsDes.message: Confirm to reset the extension configuration to default values?

RemindCaptureTipDes.message: If the file name is abnormal, please turn off auto-capture.

MarkAsSecureTip.message: Mark as secure RPC protocol, always include Cookies.

importConfigConfirm.message: Confirm to import configuration? This will overwrite all current settings.

tourStep1Body.message: Enter your Aria2 RPC address. The extension sends and exports intercepted download tasks through this connection.

tourStep2Body.message: Set where intercepted files are saved. If left empty, the extension resolves the path in order: Web UI settings (dir) → Aria2 config (dir) → Aria2 executable folder.

tourStep3Body.message: Add more RPC servers and set a URL Pattern for each (e.g. *youtube*, *.iso*). When a download URL matches the pattern, the extension automatically routes it to that server and saves to its directory — effortless file auto-sorting by source or type.

helpIntroDes.message: This extension consists of two parts: Download Interception and Task Management. This page handles settings related to download interception. Click the toolbar icon to open the main Web UI, where you can manage tasks and configure download engines.
